proposed_comments.title: Keep this regression test in the Workspaces serialized test set
proposed_comments.body:
This regression test should be serialized with the Workspaces UI suite and included in Workspaces-category test runs. Without the category, `TestCategory=Workspaces` runs skip the coverage; without `DoNotParallelize`, the suspended fixture process can race the shared Workspaces fixture cleanup/counting logic.

```suggestion
    [TestClass]
    [TestCategory("Workspaces")]
    [DoNotParallelize]
```
